in_arabic.name: مروان

historical_references.reference: Marwan I, also known as Marwan ibn Muhammad or Marwan the Great, was a Umayyad Arab caliph who ruled the Umayyad Caliphate from 684 to 685 CE. He led the Muslim army to several significant victories against the forces of Constantine IV of Byzantium during the Second Arab-Byzantine War. Marwan was succeeded by his son, Abd al-Malik.

historical_references.reference: Marwan II, known as Marwan ibn Muhammad al-Himarī or Marwan the Epic, was the Umayyad Caliph who reigned from 744 to 750 CE.
